title: API Fetch Client & HTTP Request Wrapper Guidelines
keyTechniques: Check res.ok (status in 200-299 range) explicitly before attempting to parse response body data
Pass AbortSignal with a reasonable timeout to prevent network requests from hanging indefinitely
Set default headers ('Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Accept': 'application/json') on API client requests
Parse and format error JSON payloads into human-readable error messages for UI notifications
avoid: Do not assume fetch() throws an error on 404 or 500 status codes (fetch only rejects on network failure)
Do not duplicate fetch options across multiple component files; use a centralized apiService wrapper
